pageTitle: Franco Argüello | AI Builder & Full-Stack Developer
metaDescription: Franco Argüello is an AI Builder and Full-Stack Developer building coding-agent workflows and web products.
heroIntro: I build useful web products and automate engineering workflows with coding agents.
aboutMe: I'm a Full-Stack Developer and AI Builder at Silicon Misiones. I build web products and practical automation for software teams. My recent work includes TaskAgent, a Node.js orchestrator that runs a coding-agent CLI against user stories, manages Git and build steps, streams execution logs, and hands changes to a human for review. I also work across React and Next.js interfaces, REST APIs, and SaaS product features.
contactDescription: Have a project or role in mind? Get in touch.

taskagent.name: TaskAgent
